Name: CommandCheckVoucherHandleBeforeEdit
Content:
<![CDATA[
if @@view = 0 begin
  if @@action = 'Edit' begin
    declare @$checkVoucherHandle varchar(32)
    select @$checkVoucherHandle = status from @@inquiry$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
    if exists(select 1 from dmttct where ma_ct = @@id and status = @$checkVoucherHandle and xedit = 1) begin
      select @message as script, '$NotAuthorized' as message
      return
    end
    if (@@admin <> 1) and (@$checkVoucherHandle is not null) and exists(select 1 from dmttct where ma_ct = @@id and status = @$checkVoucherHandle and right_yn = 1) begin
      if not exists(select 1 from @@sysDatabaseName..sysactionrights where user_id = @@userID and ma_ct = @@id and action_id = @$checkVoucherHandle and right_yn = 1) begin
        select @message as script, '$NotAuthorized' as message
        return
      end
      if exists(select 1 from @@sysDatabaseName..sysstatusrights where user_id = @@userID and ma_ct = @@id and status_id = @$checkVoucherHandle and r_edit = 1) begin
        select @message as script, '$NotAuthorized' as message
        return
      end
    end
  end
end
]]>

Name: CommandWhenVoucherBeforeEdit
Content:

if @@view = 0 begin
  if @@action = 'Edit' begin
    declare @$lockedDate nvarchar(512), @$denyAccess nvarchar(512), @$checkVoucherLockedDate smalldatetime, @$checkVoucherUnit varchar(32)
    select @$denyAccess = '$NotAuthorized', @$lockedDate = null, @$checkVoucherLockedDate = null
    select @$lockedDate = case when @@language = 'v' then N'Đã khóa số liệu, kiểm tra lại ngày ngày khóa sổ.' else N'Data is locked, you must modify system locked date.' end
    select @$checkVoucherLockedDate = ngay_ct, @$checkVoucherUnit = ma_dvcs from @@inquiry$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
    if @$checkVoucherLockedDate is not null begin
      create table #lockedDate (r int)
      insert into #lockedDate exec fs20_CheckLockedDateOnVoucher @@id, @$checkVoucherLockedDate, @@userID, 1
      if not exists(select * from #lockedDate where r = 1) begin
        select @message as script, @$lockedDate as message
        return
      end
    end
    if @@admin <> 1 begin
      if not exists(select 1 from sysunitrights where user_id = @@userID and ma_dvcs = @$checkVoucherUnit and r_edit = 1) begin
        select @message as script, @$denyAccess as message
        return
      end
    end
  end
end
]]>

exec FastBusiness$App$Voucher$UpdateInquiryTable @@id, '@@inquiry$partition$current', '@@prime$partition$current', 'd96$$partition$current', 'stt_rec', @stt_rec, @@operation

Name: UpdateCurrentStock
Content:
declare @q nvarchar(4000), @r tinyint
select @r = cast(val as tinyint) from options where lower(name) = 'm_round_sl'
select top 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, so_luong as sl_nhap, so_luong as sl_xuat into #currentStock from &DetailVariable;
if @post = 1 and (@@action = 'New' or @@action = 'Edit') insert into #currentStock select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, case when &StockType; = 1 then sum(round(so_luong * he_so, @r)) else 0 end as sl_nhap, case when &StockType; = 2 then sum(round(so_luong * he_so, @r)) else 0 end as sl_xuat from &DetailVariable; where qc_yn = 0 group by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo
set @q = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetSQLUpdateCurrentStock('r70$$partition$previous', 'r90$$partition$previous', @stt_rec, @@id, @@action, @Stock)
exec sp_executesql @q

Name: Post
Content:
declare @s nvarchar(4000)
select @s = ''
select @s = @s + stt_rec0 + ''',''' from d96$$partition$current where qc_yn = 1 and stt_rec = @stt_rec
if @s <> '' begin
  select @s = left(@s, len(@s) - 3)
  select @s = 'delete #in where stt_rec0 in (''' + @s + ''')'
end
  
if (@status <> '0') begin
  exec FastBusiness$Voucher$Posting$Inventory 'm96$$partition$current', 'd96$$partition$current', 'r90$$partition$current', @stt_rec, @@id, 
    'tien_nt_x, tien_xuat, gia_nt21, gia21, gia_nt2, gia2, tien_nt2, tien2, ct_dc, cp_thue_yn, px_gia_dd, pn_gia_tb',
    'so_seri, ma_khon, ma_vi_trin, so_dh2, so_dh3, ma_nv, tk_du, stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, stt_rec_dc, so_seri0',
    'gia_nt1 = b.gia_nt, gia_nt01 = b.gia_nt, gia1 = b.gia, gia01 = b.gia, tien_nhap = b.tien, tien_nt_n = b.tien_nt',
    @s, @stock, &StockType;
  insert into r90$$partition$current select * from ct90 where stt_rec = @stt_rec
end

Name: ScriptCurrency
Content:
<![CDATA[
  init: function(f) {
    this._currencyChangedHandler = Function.createDelegate(this, this.onCurrencyChanged);
    this._dateChangedHandler = Function.createDelegate(this, this.onDateChanged);
    this._currencySelectedHandler = Function.createDelegate(this, this.onCurrencySelected);
    f._currencyBehavior.addCurrencyHandler(this._currencyChangedHandler, this._dateChangedHandler, this._currencySelectedHandler);
  },
  dispose: function(f) {
    if (f._currencyBehavior) {
      if (this._currencyChangedHandler) {
        f._currencyBehavior.removeCurrencyHandler(this._currencyChangedHandler, this._dateChangedHandler, this._currencySelectedHandler);
        this._currencyChangedHandler = null;
        this._dateChangedHandler = null;
        this._currencySelectedHandler = null;
      }
      f._currencyBehavior.dispose();
    }
  },
]]>

Name: XMLGetVoucherNumber

    select rtrim(ltrim(so_ct0)) as so_ct0 , rtrim(ltrim(so_ct1)) as so_ct1, rtrim(ltrim(so_ct2)) as so_ct2, rtrim(ltrim(isnull(so_seri, ''))) as ky_hieu from v20dmnk where ma_nk = @voucherBook

  end    
]]></text></action>

Name: XMLGetExchangeRate
Content:
<action id="GetExchangeRate" ><text><![CDATA[
if exists(select 1 from dmtgnt where ma_nt = @ma_nt and ngay_ct <= @ngay_lct)
  select top 1 ty_gia as value from dmtgnt where ma_nt = @ma_nt and ngay_ct <= @ngay_lct order by ngay_ct desc
else
  select 0 as value
  
return
]]></text></action>

Name: CommandGetTaxRate
Content:
declare @taxRate numeric(5, 2), @taxType int, @taxAccount varchar(32), @taxCode varchar(32)
select @taxCode = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_ma_thue_0'
if exists(select 1 from dmthue where ma_thue = @taxCode) begin
  select @taxRate = a.thue_suat, @taxAccount = rtrim(a.tk_thue_co), @taxType = isnull(b.tk_cn, 0) from dmthue a left join dmtk b on a.tk_thue_co = b.tk where a.ma_thue = @taxCode
  select @message = @message + replace('$TaxRate=' + rtrim(str(@taxRate, 5, 2)) + ';$TaxCode=''' + @taxCode + ''';$TaxAccount=''' + @taxAccount + ''';$TaxType=' + rtrim(@taxType) + ';', '$', 'this._default')
end
